core: Control of pancreatic islet hormone secretion
name: GPCR and cAMP-PKA control of insulin and glucagon secretion
rationale: Members are GPCR inputs (GLP1, free fatty acid, hydroxycarboxylic acid, adrenergic, cholinergic receptors) and cAMP-PKA/PDE3B/glucagon signalling that tune islet insulin and glucagon release, unlike confusables centred on KATP channels, insulin processing, insulin receptor action or hepatic glucose metabolism.

name: Major spliceosome assembly and splice-site recognition
rationale: All members cover U2-type spliceosome assembly, 5'/3' splice-site recognition, tri-snRNP assembly and catalytic rearrangement, whereas confusables concern snRNA transcription, snRNP biogenesis or histone mRNA processing.

core: Cytotoxic lymphocyte regulation and peripheral tolerance
name: NK and T cell cytotoxicity, costimulation and tolerance
rationale: Members span NK cell signatures and KIR/receptor activation, granzyme killing, regulation of NK and T cell cytotoxicity, costimulation, anergy and tolerance, and DC differentiation; the NK cytotoxic arm is absent from the Treg/Th-centred confusables.

core: Removal of methyl and alkyl groups from DNA bases
qualifier: direct reversal plus TET/TDG cytosine demethylation
name: DNA base dealkylation and active cytosine demethylation
rationale: Members are direct alkylation damage reversal (MGMT, ALKBH2/3) and TET/TDG-mediated 5-methylcytosine and CpG island demethylation, distinct from confusables on glycosylase base excision repair, redox/aldehyde detoxification or APOBEC cytosine deamination.

qualifier: restraint of myeloid and B-lineage differentiation
name: Hematopoietic stem cell maintenance restraining myeloid and B-lineage differentiation
rationale: Members cover HSC homeostasis, proliferation and division plus negative regulation of macrophage, monocyte, granulocyte and B cell differentiation, whereas confusables emphasise RUNX1 programmes, erythroid/megakaryocyte lineages or bone marrow development.

name: T cell activation, TCR signalling and thymic differentiation
rationale: Members are dominated by T cell activation/signalling modules, IL2/IL7/TCR network, double-positive thymocytes and CD8 and gamma-delta T cell differentiation, while the confusables are centred on B cell receptor signalling and B cell development.

name: Atrial myocyte repolarization and AV node action potential
rationale: All three members concern atrial cardiomyocyte membrane repolarization or AV node depolarization, unlike confusables covering ventricular/Purkinje depolarization, conduction or generic channel phases.

name: Neuronal excitability, presynaptic signalling and sensorimotor behaviour
rationale: Members combine neuronal action potential and calcium-channel regulation, presynaptic active zone, inhibitory mGluR and MECP2-GABA signalling with sensorimotor behaviours (prepulse inhibition, touch, vision, voluntary movement); the presynaptic/mGluR components separate it from behaviour-only and glycinergic confusables.

name: NOD1/NOD2 sensing of bacterial peptidoglycan
rationale: All members describe NOD1/NOD2 and NLR responses to peptidoglycan and muramyl dipeptide with K63 ubiquitination, distinct from confusables on TLR-TAK1-IKK signalling and the IPAF inflammasome.

name: Mast cell Fc-epsilon receptor signalling and degranulation
rationale: Members cover FcERI-driven calcium, MAPK and NF-kB signalling, mast cell degranulation, histamine and cytokine release and type I hypersensitivity, which the Th2 and eosinophil confusables lack.

name: Fructose 2,6-bisphosphate regulation of glycolysis and pentose phosphate flux
rationale: Members concern fructose 2,6-bisphosphate metabolism controlling glycolysis, lactate fermentation and the pentose phosphate shunt, whereas confusables cover core glucose catabolism, hexokinase defects or p53/mTORC1 metabolic programmes.

name: PTK6 tyrosine kinase signalling
rationale: Every member describes PTK6 activation by ERBB2, its downregulation or its targets (STAT3, RHO/RAS, RTKs/AKT, RNA-processing proteins), unlike confusables on generic RTK, FGFR/ERBB/MET or RAS-MAPK signalling.

name: Th2 cell differentiation and type 2 cytokine signalling
rationale: Members cover Th2 differentiation, IL-4/IL-5/IL-13 production, IL-4/IL-13 and IL-33 signalling, IgE switching and nematode responses, distinguishing it from the eosinophil and mast cell FcERI confusables.

name: Xenobiotic detoxification of aflatoxin, flavonoids and steroids
rationale: Members describe biotransformation of mycotoxins/aflatoxin, polyketides, flavones/genistein and steroids including cytosolic sulfonation, while confusables centre on drug ADME, organic anion transport or other xenobiotic chemistries.

name: Arp2/3 branched-actin protrusions: lamellipodia, ruffles and podosomes
rationale: Members cover WASP/WAVE-driven Arp2/3 nucleation and regulation of lamellipodia, ruffles, pseudopodia, podosomes and macropinocytosis in cell spreading and migration, unlike confusables dominated by RHO GTPase cycles and actin severing/capping/bundling.

qualifier: zinc, manganese and cadmium import with iron export defects
name: Zinc, manganese and cadmium import with iron export disorders
rationale: Members are SLC39 zinc/manganese/cadmium influx, zinc homeostasis and starvation response, plus ferroportin and ceruloplasmin iron-export diseases, unlike confusables on metallothioneins, copper, zinc efflux or iron uptake.

name: Lysosomal heparan sulfate degradation and Sanfilippo syndromes
rationale: Members are heparan sulfate degradation and the four MPS III (Sanfilippo) defects, plus CS/DS degradation, whereas confusables cover the Hurler, Hunter, Morquio, Sly and other MPS types.

core: Fibroblast behaviour in connective tissue repair
qualifier: fibroblast migration, survival and myofibroblast differentiation
name: Fibroblast migration, survival and myofibroblast differentiation
rationale: Members regulate fibroblast migration, apoptosis and cardiac/myofibroblast differentiation and connective tissue replacement, while confusables centre on ECM assembly, collagen and TGF-beta regulation.

qualifier: break sensing and classical end joining
name: DNA double-strand break sensing and classical end joining
rationale: Members cover DSB sensing, ATM-mediated recruitment, repair-associated chromatin remodelling and ADP-ribosylation, and classical NHEJ, unlike confusables on alternative NHEJ, homologous recombination or BRCA1/2 defects.

Members split into two unrelated groups, insulin-like growth factor/peptide hormone responses with hormone-mediated apoptosis and TNFR1-driven sphingomyelin catabolism to ceramide, with no single biological process true of all.

name: Osteoblast proliferation, differentiation and bone mineralization
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast proliferation and differentiation, bone mineralization and chondrocyte development, whereas confusables emphasise Wnt/mesenchymal stem cell input, trabecula, suture and tendon development.

name: Nutrient and energy sensing upstream of mTORC1
rationale: All members concern amino acid (leucine, methionine), glucose and LKB1-AMPK energy sensing and AKT-TSC control of mTORC1 signalling, unlike confusables on glycolysis, p53 metabolism, FOXO or protein methylation.

qualifier: Fe-S cluster and lipoyl cofactor assembly
name: TCA cycle with Fe-S cluster and lipoyl cofactor assembly
rationale: Members cover TCA intermediates, OGDH, succinate dehydrogenase and NADPH-producing isocitrate metabolism together with Fe-S cluster assembly and protein lipoylation that mature TCA enzymes, distinct from confusables on PDH/CoA synthesis, malate-aspartate shuttle or lysine/glycine catabolism.

name: Inhibition of VEGF-driven sprouting angiogenesis
rationale: Every member is negative regulation of VEGF receptor signalling or endothelial proliferation, migration and chemotaxis in sprouting angiogenesis, while confusables are pro-angiogenic, Tie2 or adhesion-focused.

qualifier: nodal axon domains and connexin gap junctions
name: Nodal axon domains and connexin gap junction assembly
rationale: Members combine L1-family/neurofascin/NrCAM-ankyrin and LGI-ADAM interactions building paranodes and sodium channel clusters for action potential propagation with connexin trafficking and gap junction formation, the latter absent from myelination and L1-adhesion confusables.
